method_choices.why: Useful for understanding whether the linked score lane is harmonically varied or collapsing into a narrow set of repeated shapes.
Motion between notes and chords often explains more than isolated counts. It shows how pieces travel, not only where they stop.
A sparse score lane should invite contribution before it is turned into a market claim.

claim_boundaries: The repository can parse notation, MIDI, ABC, LilyPond, tablature, and chord charts.
No note-bearing assets are linked strongly enough yet to support harmonic claims across the public catalog.
This lane is currently best used to show where deeper evidence is still missing.
